consultations.action: Read actual OCR and inspected both full page images, not merely the ledger. WB06's grouped sum and p.191's bottom whole-numerator division support keeping p+q together above r. TR02/TR03 support equivalent-fraction and common-factor reduction wording. The ledger's সমতুল ভগ্নাংশ is retained consistently, while noting TR02's regional synonym তুল্য ভগ্নাংশ. Exclude the unrelated WB p.191 example 5's flat x2/y2 misprinting and Tripura p.51's faulty mixed-number intermediate denominator. OpenStax, not the Bengali witnesses, is the mathematical authority.

Returned to actual OCR against the page images already inspected for this section. Used the distinction between মান বসানো, ঘাতের মান নির্ণয় and final লঘিষ্ঠ আকার instead of translating every Simplify instruction identically. In the three-factor product, the intermediate step means multiplying numerators and denominators, while the next step divides both by their common factor 4.
